title: EvaluationResult
description: The response the engine returns for one piece of content. Contains no content text and no raw prompts, so it is safe to log widely. Join to the restricted audit record on request_id.

execution_kind.description: live is a real judge run. mock must not be read later as measured performance.

request_id.description: UUID4 generated per evaluation. Primary key for the audit record.

policy_sha256.description: Hash of the policy file bytes used. Proves exactly which prompts and weights were in force.

threshold.description: Threshold in force. Null unless strategy is weighted_threshold.

score.description: Weighted risk score. Null unless strategy is weighted_threshold.

decision_reason.description: Locked to final_verdict and evaluation_strategy. ALLOW is no_trigger. REVIEW is needs_review. BLOCK and REDACT are threshold_met under weighted_threshold, one_violation under all (any failing rule violates), and all_rules_failed under any (every applicable rule failed).

triggered_rules.description: Rules whose FAIL counted toward the decision.

uncertain_rules.description: Rules that returned UNCERTAIN or errored.

review_reasons.description: Why the verdict is REVIEW, or why REVIEW was part of the decision. Empty if not.

rule_results.description: One entry per rule that ran, in policy order.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the UTF-8 bytes of json.dumps({"mode": mode, "text": text}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")). No trimming and no Unicode normalization. The original text is hashed, not a truncated copy. The same characters hash differently as input and as output because mode is part of the preimage.

truncated.description: True if content exceeded max_content_chars and the judges saw a truncated copy.

totals.description: Sums over every attempt, including failed ones. If any attempt left a token count or cost unreported, that total is null. Do not write 0 for an unknown figure.

total_latency_ms.description: Wall-clock for the whole evaluation. With parallel rules this is close to the slowest rule, not the sum.

confidence.description: The judge's confidence in its verdict. 0 when the judge errored.

reasoning.description: From the judge. For errors the engine writes a short fixed message.

action.description: FAIL -> the rule's on_fail. UNCERTAIN or error -> review. PASS -> none.

risk_contribution.description: weight * confidence if FAIL, else 0. The term that enters the noisy-OR score.

attempts.description: Judge calls made for this rule (1 = no retry).

latency_ms.description: Total time for this rule including retries and backoff.

error.description: Set only when the rule never produced a valid judge response. Then verdict is UNCERTAIN.
